audit_1_query_preservation.description: Verify original query survives DAG and is preserved in prompt and response without corruption.

normalizer_emits_query.details: Trims query and outputs { query: trimmed }.

greeting_classifier_preserves_query.details: Preserves trimmed query alongside is_greeting flag.

validate_query_vector_restores_query.details: Restores original query from Greeting Classifier into vector output item.

aggregate_gate_preserves_query_across_em.details: Fetches query from $('Validate Query Vector') regardless of whether SQL returns rows or empty results.

prompt_includes_user_query.details: Embeds preserved query verbatim into SECTION C of the prompt.

final_response_contains_original_query.details: Final JSON output payload maps query from prior.query.

audit_2_merge_and_empty_results.description: Verify Merge v3 behavior, alwaysOutputData empty placeholder handling, and absence of false positive chunks.

postgres_always_output_data.details: Framework alwaysOutputData=True, Voice alwaysOutputData=True. Guarantees both inputs to Merge v3 always resolve without hanging.

placeholder_rejection_no_false_positives.details: Aggregation strictly verifies j.id !== undefined and stream_type matching, eliminating alwaysOutputData empty placeholder objects from qualifying chunk counts.

audit_3_postgresql_parameter_binding.description: Inspect PostgreSQL nodes for parameterized binding, pgvector casting, thresholds, and limits.

framework_parameter_binding.details: Safe parameter replacement via queryReplacement expression into $1::vector.

voice_parameter_binding.details: Safe parameter replacement via queryReplacement expression into $1::vector.

no_unsafe_sql_interpolation.details: Zero template string or expression interpolation inside SQL text. Pure parameterized SQL.

audit_4_branch_behavior.description: Verify greeting bypass, vector validation halt on invalid vectors, and zero-result hard gate isolation.

greeting_branch_routes_to_static_only.details: True condition connects solely to Static Greeting Response.

static_greeting_is_terminal.details: Terminal node: zero outgoing edges. Bypasses embedding, database, and LLM.

invalid_vector_throws_exception.details: Throws immediate error if vector is missing, dimension != 1024, or non-finite, halting execution before PostgreSQL.

zero_result_routes_to_fallback_only.details: False condition connects solely to Return Zero Result Output.

zero_result_fallback_is_terminal.details: Terminal node: zero outgoing edges. Bypasses generation LLM completely.

audit_5_prompt_integrity.description: Verify section separation, voice non-conflation, strict constraints, and exact fallback string.

section_separation.details: Strict 4-section architecture separating conceptual framework facts from voice style samples.

voice_style_calibration_constraint.details: Explicitly forbids voice samples from being treated as conceptual frameworks or inventing statements for Dr. Sara.

exact_fallback_string_verified.exact_string: No documented coaching frameworks match this topic.
